name: gideon-ui
description: GIDEON desktop UI: Electron shell + Vite/TypeScript renderer talking to the Python backend over WebSocket.
author: hekimcan206

scripts.gen:protocol: json2ts --input ../protocol/schema.json --output src/shared/protocol.ts --unreachableDefinitions --additionalProperties false --bannerComment "/* Generated from protocol/schema.json by json-schema-to-typescript. Do not edit; run npm run gen:protocol. */"
scripts.build: npm run build:electron && npm run build:renderer
